name: Liquid Network Peg-Out Bulletin Board
description: Addresses from the September 2026 Liquid Network incident, in which self-described whitehats used an L-BTC inflation bug and a valid SideSwap peg-out authorization to withdraw ~3,996 BTC (about 95% of federation reserves) in block 965,783. The hackers, Blockstream security and the usual crowd of lawyers, launderers and wallet ads are all talking through OP_RETURN.

addresses.label: Hacker holding address (~3,998 BTC; 'we are whitehats. contact us on chain')
Liquid federation peg-out address (drained; hackers reply to it on chain)
Peg-out intermediary (received the 3,996 BTC in tx 8db751...a7b140, forwarded same block)
Blockstream security responder (PGP-signed / ECIES-encrypted messages to the hackers)

name: Coldcard Exploit Bulletin Board
description: Main attacker consolidation addresses from the July-August 2026 Coldcard firmware RNG exploit. These became the most active public OP_RETURN message boards, filled with begging, laundry ads, threats, haikus, philosophical notes and prompt injections.

name: High-Value Dormant Wallet Notices
description: High-balance early (mostly 2010-2011) addresses that have received systematic OP_RETURN legal notices, ownership claims, phishing links and 'abandoned property' messages (including the 2025 Salomon Brothers-style campaigns).

addresses.label: Famous Mt. Gox related address (~80k BTC)

name: Genesis & Satoshi Tribute
description: The Genesis block address. A long-running cultural phenomenon where people send symbolic tributes, memorials, and messages to Satoshi.

name: Russian Intelligence Marking Campaign
description: Addresses publicly labeled via OP_RETURN in early 2022 as belonging to Russian intelligence agencies (GRU / SVR / FSB). Classic geopolitical on-chain marking campaign.

name: Cultural Memorials & Digital Graffiti
description: Addresses and vanity addresses associated with permanent cultural tributes, memorials, religious messages, and early digital graffiti on Bitcoin.

name: Historical Hacker Negotiation Boards
description: Addresses from past major incidents that have been used for public on-chain negotiation, bounty offers, threats, or responses between victims, projects, and attackers.

addresses.label: Mt. Gox related (also appears in dormant notices)
